contract.api: set_results_view(sort_column:string="",descending:bool=false,filter:null|{column,operator,value?}) replaces criteria atomically. reset_results_view()/show_results_view() take no arguments. save_results_view(path) exports current projection; save_results unchanged all acquisition rows. contract.filter: Operators gt/ge/lt/le/eq/ne require finite numeric threshold preserving signed/unsigned exactness; contains/equals_text use literal case-sensitive UTF8 byte matching with bounded text; is_missing/is_null/is_nan take no value. No coercion of explicit strings/Booleans/compound JSON to numbers. Native managed numeric omissions use existing numericState defaults including numericNaN, independently of textual presentation.
contract.sort: Ascending total type order numbers(-Inf,finite,+Inf,NaN),UTF8 bytewise strings,Booleans(false/true),compound stable ties,null,opaque missing. Descending reverses total order; equal keys preserve current acquisition order, including signed zero/equal int/float. Exact signed/uint64/double cross-comparison avoids precision loss. Raw rows and numeric provenance remain owned by existing table.
contract.invalidation: One derived cache of at most two consumed scalar keys per source row plus one visible row-index vector. Borrow/equality-check only sort/filter cells to detect writable C++ cell edits and default-state changes; no full-table copy/hash/serialization each frame, no numeric provenance ledger. Rebuild only if consumed equivalence keys/count/criteria change. Compound values form stable type ties and never numeric/text match, so their payload is not copied. Draw/export always borrow current original rows by index. Default/reset has no projection cache and stays identity order.
contract.ui: Results View... opens existing ask modal with column text fields, human operator choices, literal text or parsed numeric threshold, descending and Apply/Cancel. Reset view restores acquisition projection; explicit visible/total counts and current criteria. Existing Copy/Save buttons export the displayed view with view-specific labels when active. Separate save_results API stays all rows; add explicit Save all CSV in active view. Shared formatter/column choices/quoting/NaN policy preserved.
